review_scope: Full-body architectural review; no clinical certification; excludes all prior 1554 reviewed IDs.

reviews.title: Pediatric Emergency Registry
reviews.body:
# Pediatric Emergency Registry

Stores emergency medical events.

Supports

• Fever

• Seizures

• Trauma

• Poisoning

• Hospital Admissions

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Emergency specialty profiles preserve clinician-led urgency, source event/triage/transfer provenance and minimum-necessary passport disclosure. Historical templates and device connectivity do not establish a staffed response service or autonomous diagnosis/treatment. Patient instability must not wait for AI, data completion or administrative clearance.

reviews.title: Pediatric Prehospital Trauma & Emergency Transfer Module
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Preserve critical clinical information from the point of injury through emergency transport and hospital admission.

Core Functions:
• Injury Time
• Injury Location Context
• Mechanism
• Initial Clinical Status
• Vital Signs
• Neurological Status
• Airway Intervention
• Respiratory Support
• Circulatory Support
• Immobilization
• Medication
• Procedures
• Transport Mode
• Receiving Facility
• Transfer Timeline
• Handover Documentation

Interoperability:
Supports structured transfer of clinically relevant information between emergency services and receiving institutions.

Medical Passport Integration:
Authorized emergency information may provide critical diagnoses, allergies, medications and implanted-device data.

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Transfer retains point-of-injury times, interventions and sending/receiving identities with acknowledgement, reconciliation and clock uncertainty; transport location is sensitive and distinct from clinical record authority.

reviews.title: Pediatric Ocular Trauma & Emergency Ophthalmology Module
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Provide rapid structured management of pediatric ocular trauma and emergency eye conditions.

Core Functions:
• Injury Event
• Injury Mechanism
• Visual Acuity
• External Eye Injury
• Corneal Injury
• Globe Injury
• Orbital Injury
• Foreign Body
• Chemical Exposure
• Imaging
• Emergency Procedures
• Surgery
• Medication
• Complication Monitoring
• Visual Recovery

Emergency Workflow:
Presentation → Immediate Assessment → Imaging/Examination → Intervention → Follow-up → Visual Rehabilitation.

Integrations:
• Emergency Medicine
• Ophthalmology
• Trauma
• Radiology
• Surgery

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Emergency pathway diagrams are documentation flow, not mandatory sequencing that could delay clinician-directed urgent care for imaging or administrative steps.

reviews.title: Pediatric Dental Infection & Odontogenic Emergency Module
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Support rapid assessment and coordinated management of pediatric odontogenic infection and dental emergencies.

Core Functions:
• Dental Pain
• Local Infection
• Abscess
• Facial Swelling
• Fever Context
• Tooth Origin
• Imaging
• Airway Risk Context
• Medication
• Antibiotic Exposure
• Drainage
• Endodontic Procedure
• Extraction
• Hospital Referral
• Treatment Response
• Complication Surveillance

Integrations:
• Dentistry
• Emergency Medicine
• Maxillofacial Surgery
• ENT
• Infectious Disease
• Pharmacy

Safety:
Potentially severe spreading infection or airway involvement can enter clinician-defined escalation workflows.

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Spreading odontogenic infection/airway risk has a clinician-defined escalation route; automated classification cannot rule out airway compromise or independently prescribe antibiotics.

reviews.title: Pediatric Dental Emergency Passport & Implant/Device Registry Module
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Preserve clinically important dental, orthodontic and maxillofacial information for emergency and cross-provider care.

Passport Data:
• Major Dental Conditions
• Dental Trauma History
• Maxillofacial Surgery
• Orthodontic Appliances
• Dental Implants where applicable
• Craniofacial Devices
• Allergies
• Critical Medication
• Bleeding Risk Context
• Immunosuppression Context
• Relevant Systemic Disease
• Special Communication Needs

Device Registry:
• Appliance Type
• Implant/Device Type
• Placement Date
• Anatomical Location
• Manufacturer where applicable
• Current Status
• Removal/Replacement History

Cross-Border Functions:
• Multilingual Summary
• Standardized Terminology
• Source Verification
• Authorized Emergency Access

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Dental/craniofacial device passport retains placement/removal/replacement/current status and communication/bleeding-risk context. It references device-owner facts without creating a second authoritative registry.

reviews.title: Pediatric Ovarian Torsion & Gynecological Emergency Module
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Support rapid structured coordination of suspected or confirmed pediatric ovarian torsion and other acute gynecological presentations.

Core Functions:
• Acute Pain
• Symptom Onset
• Laterality
• Clinical Assessment
• Vital Signs
• Laboratory Context
• Ultrasound
• Doppler Context
• Surgical Consultation
• Procedure
• Ovarian Preservation Context
• Pathology where applicable
• Postoperative Monitoring
• Recurrence Risk
• Follow-up

Emergency Workflow:
Presentation → Assessment → Imaging → Specialist Review → Intervention → Follow-up.

Safety:
The platform supports escalation but does not use automated rules to exclude torsion.

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Preserve explicit no-automated-rule-out torsion safeguard, laterality and onset. Imaging workflow labels cannot delay urgent specialist assessment.

reviews.title: Pediatric Testicular Torsion, Acute Scrotum & Urological Emergency Module
reviews.body:

Core Functions:
• Symptom Onset

• Laterality
• Examination
• Associated Symptoms
• Ultrasound Context
• Doppler Context
• Surgical Consultation
• Procedure
• Testicular Viability Context
• Contralateral Procedure Context
• Postoperative Care
• Follow-up
• Long-term Testicular Health

Emergency Workflow:
Presentation → Immediate Assessment → Specialist Review → Intervention → Follow-up.

Safety:
Automated systems must never be used to rule out torsion or delay urgent specialist assessment.

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Automated systems cannot rule out torsion or delay urgent assessment. Preserve viability and contralateral procedure context as clinician-recorded outcomes.

reviews.title: Pediatric Ocular Trauma & Ophthalmic Emergency Module
reviews.body:
Purpose:
Support rapid structured assessment and continuity of care following pediatric eye injury.

Core Functions:
• Injury Mechanism
• Laterality
• Time of Injury
• Visual Acuity
• External Injury
• Anterior Segment
• Posterior Segment Context
• Foreign Body Context
• Chemical Exposure Context
• Imaging
• Emergency Procedure
• Surgery
• Medication
• Follow-up
• Visual Outcome

Safety:
Potentially sight-threatening presentations enter immediate clinician-defined emergency pathways.

Integrations:
• Ophthalmology
• Emergency Medicine
• Surgery
• Radiology
• Medical Passport

Status:
Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Laterality, injury time and anterior/posterior segment context extend earlier eye-emergency profiles; sight-threatening presentations require clinician-defined immediate pathways.
